chunks: Al-Ḥusayn ibn Muḥammad, from Muʿallā ibn Muḥammad, from Al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī al-Washshāʾ, from ʿAbd al-Karīm ibn ʿAmr, from Ibn Abī Yaʿfūr, who said:

I heard Abā ʿAbdillāh (عليه السلام) saying: Indeed, ʿUmar ibn ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz wrote to Ibn Ḥazm. Then he mentioned something similar to it, except that he said: Ibn Ḥazm sent for Zayd ibn al-Ḥasan, and he was older than my father (عليه السلام).
A number of our companions, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from al-Washshāʾ — similarly to it.

key_terms.أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Imam Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq (عليه السلام), the speaker in the report
key_terms.أَبِي: A reference to the father of Imam al-Ṣādiq (عليه السلام), i.e., Imam al-Bāqir (عليه السلام)
key_terms.ابْنِ أَبِي يَعْفُورٍ: A narrator transmitting from Imam al-Ṣādiq (عليه السلام)
key_terms.ابْنِ حَزْمٍ: The recipient of the letter and the one who sent for Zayd ibn al-Ḥasan
key_terms.الْوَشَّاءِ: Al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī al-Washshāʾ, a narrator in the chain
key_terms.زَيْدِ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ: A descendant of Imam al-Ḥasan (عليه السلام) mentioned in the report
key_terms.عُمَرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ: The Umayyad ruler mentioned as writing a letter

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith from al-Kāfī say about ʿUmar ibn ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz, Ibn Ḥazm, and Zayd ibn al-Ḥasan?
ai.summary: This report preserves a historical narration from Imam al-Ṣādiq (عليه السلام) concerning correspondence involving ʿUmar ibn ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz and Ibn Ḥazm, and a summons sent to Zayd ibn al-Ḥasan. It also notes Zayd ibn al-Ḥasan’s seniority in age over the Imam’s father (عليه السلام), giving biographical and historical context within the transmission.

en.hubeali: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin uhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Ali Al Washa, from Abdul Kareem Bin Amro, from Ibn Abu Yafour who said,

‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘Umar Bin Abdul Aziz (the governor) wrote to Ibn Hazim (the judge)’, then he mentioned similar to it, except that he<sup>asws</sup> said, ‘Ibn Hazim sent for Zayd son of Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>, and he was older than my<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup>’’.
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Washha - similar to it.
en.sarwar: عِدَّةٌ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ الْوَشَّاءِ مِثْلَهُ 4. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Mu‘alla ibn Muhammad from al-Hassan ibn Ali al-Washsha’ from ‘Abd al-Karim ibn ‘Amr from ibn abu Ya‘fur who has said that he heard abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) say the following. “ ‘Umar ibn ‘Abd al-‘Aziz wrote ibn Hazm. He then have narrated a hadith similar to the above one except that he has said, “Ibn Hazm sent to Zayd ibn al-Hassan who was older than my father.”
A number of our people has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Washsha’ a similar hadith.
